name: playground
install:
[ ! -d '/agent/repos/playground' ] || cd '/agent/repos/playground' || exit $?
test -f monster-truck-learning/index.html
test -f monster-truck-learning/game.js
test -f monster-truck-learning/styles.css
test -d monster-truck-learning/audio/default
test -d monster-truck-learning/img
command -v python3 >/dev/null
echo "monster-truck-learning static game is present"
start:
[ ! -d '/agent/repos/playground' ] || cd '/agent/repos/playground' || exit $?
set -euo pipefail
port_open() {
  python3 -c 'import socket,sys; s=socket.socket(); s.settimeout(0.4); sys.exit(0 if s.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", 8080))==0 else 1)'
}
if port_open; then
  echo "monster-truck server already listening on 8080"
  exit 0
fi
exec python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory monster-truck-learning
